observations: Two stacked IBC (Intermediate Bulk Container) tanks, one white (bottom) and one black (top), both in metal cages.
The white tank has a label with 'Paperkem' and 'NON-HAZARDOUS' visible in photo 1.
The white tank shows some surface wear, chipped paint, and dirt, especially on the metal cage and base.
The black tank above has a faded label with 'NSF' and '1000L' visible in photo 0.
Both tanks have visible fittings: a blue valve on the bottom of the black tank and a spigot on the bottom of the white tank.
The white tank has a 'T-S' marking on its side in photo 1.
The tanks are outdoors on a dirt ground, stacked, suggesting storage or resale.

claims.claim: White Tank for your water reserves and chemicals etc
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows a white IBC tank with a 'NON-HAZARDOUS' label, consistent with use for water or non-hazardous chemicals.

risks.risk: Internal contamination or residue from previous contents
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the inside of the tank, or a video showing the interior after draining.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially contaminated, reducing value

risks.risk: Structural damage or cracks in the plastic body not visible from outside
risks.proof: A photo showing the entire tank from all sides, including the bottom and seams, or a video inspection.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly damaged, reducing value

risks.proof: A photo or video showing the tank filled with water and left for a few hours to check for leaks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly leaking, reducing value

proof_requests: A close-up photo of the inside of the white tank to check for residue or damage.
A full 360-degree photo or video of the white tank, including bottom and seams.
A photo or video of the tank filled with water to test for leaks.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a white IBC tank, and the seller's claim is supported by the photos. Hidden risks exist but are common to used tanks; the item can be priced at its worst case (contaminated, cracked, or leaking) until proof is provided.
